Upon receiving conflicting information from the WebSurfer (Wikipedia indicating 1940 and IMDb indicating 1945 for "Ghar Ki Rani"), the Planner incorrectly concluded that the canonical release year was 2007. This conclusion was based on a misinterpretation of the search results, likely confusing the "Release info" page for a different film or misreading the metadata. The Planner failed to resolve the ambiguity between the 1940 and 1945 dates by selecting the most authoritative source (Wikipedia explicitly states 1940) or by verifying the 2007 claim, instead arbitrarily choosing 2007. This led to the false conclusion that "Ghar Ki Rani" was released in 2007, causing the final answer to be incorrect (Heaven Help Us was actually released first in 1985, but the reasoning for Ghar Ki Rani's date was fabricated).
